name: Personalization_Bench
description: Personalization_Bench evaluates a model's ability to produce personalized outputs given a user profile, preferences, and prior interactions. It measures how well models adapt content, style, and recommendations to different simulated users across multi-turn scenarios. The benchmark is intended to test memory, preference alignment, and personalization robustness.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented dataset with limited but growing use in personalization and dialogue adaptation studies.
